verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents automatic retry of transient failures or resuming interrupted syncs from checkpoints. The closest items are adjacent: automatic incremental syncs, alerts, manual re-sync controls, and general community praise for reliability. None of these show retry or checkpoint-resume behavior, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, transient failures retry automatically and interrupted syncs resume from checkpoints instead of restarting
